node_overview.buffers_description: Buffers are built to cache small amounts of messages for a very short time (usually milliseconds) on their way through the different processors.
node_overview.disk_journal_description: Incoming messages are written to the disk journal to ensure they are kept safe in case of a server failure. The journal also helps maintain functionality if any of the outputs is too slow to keep up with the message rate or whenever there is a peak in incoming messages. It makes sure that memory is not overloaded and avoids overly long garbage collection pauses that way.
